it.txt: Era vice-prefeito e assumiu a prefeitura depois que Gleydson Resende renunciou ao cargo (carta de renúncia de 29/03/2026, publicada no Diário Oficial do município de 30/03/2026), para disputar a eleição de 2026 para deputado estadual. No Diário Oficial de 30/03/2026, ele já assina como prefeito.
it.txt_en: He was vice mayor and took over as mayor after Mayor Gleydson Resende resigned (resignation letter dated March 29, 2026, published in the city's Official Gazette on March 30, 2026) to run for state deputy in the 2026 election. In the Official Gazette of March 30, 2026, he already signs as mayor.
